name: Sparta Leonidas
look: A still from the film 300. Gerard Butler as King Leonidas, bearded and wearing a red cape, roars toward the camera with a curved sword raised, while fallen soldiers, shields and spears litter the hazy battlefield behind him.
use: An over-the-top battle cry about something that doesn't deserve it. Captions usually riff on his line 'This is Sparta!', shouting 'This is [something]!' about a petty rule or situation, or any wildly dramatic declaration.
slots: top caption: the setup or challenge
bottom caption: the shouted reply, often 'This is [something]!'
examples: You want to borrow my phone charger?
Did someone just take my parking spot?
describe: bearded spartan king screaming with a sword in battle
gerard butler yelling in a red cape from 300
angry warrior shouting with his blade raised on a battlefield
shirtless soldier with a cape roaring a battle cry
furious bearded man screaming at the camera holding a sword
origin: From the film 300, in which Gerard Butler plays King Leonidas leading Spartan soldiers against the Persian army.
